newsitem.title: USA: PETsMART names Ecton chief oper officer.
newsitem.headline: PETsMART names Ecton chief oper officer.

text.p: PETsMart Inc said it named Donna Ecton to the newly created position of chief operating officer and said Samuel Parker, the current chairman, has agreed to remain at PETsMART in the newly created position of non-executive chairman through June 2000.

The appointment is subject to his re-election at the company's annual stockholder meeting in June 1997. In his new role, Parker will assist management in the areas of strategy, development and corporate governance, the company said in a statement released on Monday.
Ecton has served as a director of PETsMART since June 1994, and has been chairman, president and chief executive officer of Business Mail Express Inc, since 1995.
In addition, Donald Dorsey, PETsMART's executive vice president and chief financial officer has agreed to extend his employment arrangement with PETsMART for an additional year to January 1999.
